bullets.text: Age Verification Wars Intensify - **UK**'s Online Safety Act mandates age-gating on social media and adult sites.
Apple Vision Pro's Game Changer - Live **NBA** games in **Apple Immersive Video** set to enhance user experience.
Strava's IPO Buzz - **Strava** eyes public listing as user base surges to 50 million monthly active users.
ZoraSafe App Launch - Aims to protect older users from online scams with gamified learning.
Nvidia's AI Investment Surge - **Nvidia** accelerates startup investments, capitalizing on the AI boom.
Elon Musk's Regulatory Challenges - **Tesla** faces scrutiny over Full Self-Driving tech and insurance practices.
